sources.title: Solar Pro 2: model specifications and versions
sources.evidence: Names Solar Pro 2, gives 31B parameters and 65,536-token context, and marks chat, reasoning and tool calling supported. Lists English, Korean and Japanese. The rolling solar-pro2 alias points to solar-pro2-251215; versions include the July 10, 2025 release. Announces October 30, 2026 service retirement.

sources.title: Solar Pro 2 Preview: Small. Powerful. Now with reasoning.
sources.evidence: Dated May 20, 2025 and explicitly says Solar Pro 2 Preview is available on Upstage Console. Describes 31B parameters, 64K context and selectable chat/reasoning modes, with a full release still forthcoming.

sources.title: Solar Pro 2: Fluent. Reasoning. Frontier.
sources.evidence: July 10, 2025 general-release announcement identifies Upstage, repeats 31B, and documents multilingual language generation, reasoning and tool use. Provides API access and describes commercial cloud/on-premises deployment.

sources.title: Solar Pro 2 Breaks Into Global Frontier AI
sources.evidence: July 21, 2025 announcement explicitly calls Solar Pro 2 Upstage’s proprietary LLM and repeats its 31-billion-parameter size.

sources.title: Compare models
sources.evidence: Later comparison table has an exact Solar Pro 2 column with 31B parameters and 65,536 context. It separately labels Solar Mini 4’s total/active counts, but gives no active count or network architecture for Solar Pro 2.

sources.title: Solar Open Technical Report
sources.evidence: January 2026 report identifies Solar Pro 2 as a synthetic-data generator and fine-tuned query generator, citing its launch. It does not disclose Solar Pro 2’s network type or active count; its MoE architecture specifications describe Solar Open.

sources.title: Solar Pro2 Prompting Handbook (English)
sources.evidence: Official notebook uses the exact solar-pro2 identifier in chat-completion examples with text messages and textual responses. Explains low/high reasoning_effort; its use of hybrid describes selectable reasoning modes, not a disclosed network architecture.

developer.note: The developer identifies the model as its own.

family.note: Retains the catalog’s normalized Solar Pro family label; the preview names Solar Pro as its predecessor.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit public availability is the May 20 preview. July 10 is the later general release, not first availability.

open_weights.note: Proprietary model offered through API and commercial deployment; these sources do not describe a public weight release.

license.note: Supported descriptive classification from Upstage’s explicit proprietary designation, not an invented named license.

parameters_b.note: Nominal author-reported total in billions. No public checkpoint count was performed.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately labeled active count found in the model specifications, later comparison table or later technical report. Do not equate the 31B total with active parameters.

architecture.note: No exact-model dense/MoE/hybrid network specification found after checking official launch material, model documentation, later research and architecture/training searches. Hybrid in the handbook means selectable chat/reasoning modes; Solar Open’s MoE design cannot be transferred here.

context_window.note: Exact documented context length; the preview’s rounded 64K statement is consistent.

modalities.note: Exact-model official examples use text prompts and textual completions. No image/audio capability is added from separate document-processing products.

reasoning.note: Selectable reasoning mode is explicitly documented.

tool_call.note: The exact model specifications mark tool calling supported.

description.value: Upstage text model with chat and reasoning modes, tool calling, and support for English, Korean, and Japanese.
description.note: Replaces the broad flagship/production-workflow wording with documented features.

Solar Pro 2 Preview: Small. Powerful. Now with reasoning.
Solar Pro 2 Breaks Into Global Frontier AI

patch.notes: 31B is Upstage’s nominal total; active parameters and neural architecture are not disclosed in the reviewed sources. The release date is the May 20, 2025 public preview; general availability followed on July 10. The rolling solar-pro2 alias currently maps to solar-pro2-251215. Upstage documents retirement on October 30, 2026; specifications do not establish current endpoint operation.

summary: Confirms 31B nominal parameters, 65,536 context, text input/output, reasoning and tool calling. Adds the supported proprietary classification and direct primary provenance, and replaces the promotional description. Retains May 20, 2025 as public-preview availability, distinguishing the July 10 full release. Active parameters and neural architecture remain undisclosed after later-source checks.
